post.caption:
Mohenjo-daro and Harappa had grid streets, standardised bricks with consistent ratios across hundreds of kilometres, private bathrooms draining into covered street sewers, a great public bath and granaries. All around 2500 BCE. The stranger detail is what is missing: no palaces, no grand tombs, nothing that reads as a king. And the script is still undeciphered, so we know their engineering intimately and their language not at all.
